name: What is the importance of proper sealing and caulking during window trim repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the importance of proper sealing and caulking during window trim repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper sealing and caulking are crucial components of effective window trim repair. They create a weather-tight barrier that prevents moisture from penetrating behind the trim and into the wall structure, which can lead to rot, mold, and energy loss. High-quality caulk also seals air leaks, improving your home's energy efficiency. Over time, caulk can degrade, so replacing it during repair maintains the protective seal and appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper sealing and caulking prevent moisture intrusion, inhibit rot and mold, seal air leaks, and enhance energy efficiency, protecting your home.
